daySchedules.title: Day 1 — Technology Talk & Anniversary Gala Night
daySchedules.venue: Wyndham Hotel, Muscat, Sultanate of Oman
daySchedules.subtitle: Connect & Celebrate — High-level technology keynotes, professional licensing talks, ASEAN Engineer Registry conferment, and the annual gala.

sessions.title: Session I: Learn & Develop — Technology & Professional Org Talks

items.title: Registration, Welcome Breakfast & Networking
items.description: Check-in of in-person delegates, distribution of conference kits, badge issuance, and coffee networking.

items.title: Opening Ceremony
items.description: Invocation, National Anthems of the Sultanate of Oman and the Republic of the Philippines, and ICpEP Hymn.

items.title: Welcome Address
items.description: Opening of the TechTalk 2026 conference and welcoming of local and international delegations.

items.title: Anniversary Message & Organizational Milestones
items.description: Celebrating ICpEP-Oman's leadership journey, regional achievements, and commitment to overseas computer engineers.

items.title: Opening Keynote Address I
items.description: Strategic insights on higher education, engineering standards, and international competitiveness of Filipino computer engineers.

items.title: Opening Keynote Address II
items.description: Diplomatic relations, professional welfare, and government support for Filipino professionals in the Sultanate of Oman.

items.title: Professional Org Talk: The Future of Filipino Engineers
items.description: Professional excellence, global recognition, and engineering leadership across borderless economies.

items.title: Professional Org Talk: Pathways to Professional Engineering Registration
items.description: Competency frameworks, portfolio assessment, peer review, and international recognition requirements.

items.title: Professional Org Talk: Engineering Beyond Borders
items.description: International practice mobility, ASEAN recognition frameworks, and emerging opportunities across the MENA region.

speakers.name: Engr. Trese Bustamante
speakers.role: Vice Chair, PTC-ERB & PTC-MENA International Affairs

items.title: Industry Talk: Maintaining High Renewable Energy Penetration in Modern Power Grids
items.description: Grid stability, renewable integration models, and digital power management in Oman and the GCC.

items.title: Industry Talk: Enabling the Intelligent Factory
items.description: Hardware, software, and service solutions helping modern electronics manufacturers build the intelligent smart factory.

items.title: Industry Talk: From Strategy to Scale — Building Secure, Production-Ready AI Solutions
items.description: Enterprise AI adoption, security postures, zero-trust inference pipelines, and scalable network architectures.

items.title: Industry Leaders Panel: What Skills Will Engineers/IT/ComSci Need in the Next Five Years?
items.description: High-level interactive panel examining AI orchestration, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and global professional licensing.

items.title: TechTalk Day 2 Orientation & Launch of ICpEP-Oman Virtual Classroom
items.description: Orientation for Day 2 virtual breakouts, Cisco NetAcad integration, and rollout of self-paced certification tracks.

items.title: Concluding  Remarks
items.description: Closing Remarks from the main Technology Institute collaborator

speakers.name: Dr. Ali Humaid Mohammed AL Alawi

items.title: Batch's Valedictory Speech

items.description: Grand gala buffet dinner at Wyndham Hotel, live ambient music, and fellowship with dignitaries.

items.title: Gala Opening Ceremony
items.description: Invocation, ceremonial toasts, and welcome protocol.

items.title: ICpEP-Oman Anniversary Video Presentation
items.description: Documentary commemorating organizational milestones, community projects, and chapter history.

items.title: Special Anniversary Presentation & Fellowship Socials
items.description: Anniversary cultural showcase, musical presentation, commemorative group photography, and networking toast.

items.description: Networking rooms categorized by specializations (AI, Cloud, Cyber, Hardware).

items.title: Opening Ceremony of Online Workshop Day
items.description: Opening prayer, virtual house rules, and overview of the Day 2 learning tracks.

items.title: Workshop Session 1: Enabling the Intelligent Factory
items.description: Deep dive into hardware, software, and service solutions helping electronics manufacturers build the Intelligent Factory. Practical automation use cases, SMT machine telemetry, and predictive maintenance.

items.title: Workshop Session 2: From Network Strategy to AI at Scale
items.description: Architecting enterprise-ready, secure, resilient network and compute infrastructure for production AI inference, zero-trust enforcement, and high-throughput workflows.

items.title: Workshop Session 3: PTC Global MENA Oman Write-Shop
items.description: Practical mentoring session on preparing engineering competency portfolios for international registration ('Attend Now, Pay Later' initiative). Hands-on documentation guidance.

shortCourses.title: Introduction to Modern Artificial Intelligence
shortCourses.description: Foundational AI architectures, large language models, prompt engineering, generative tooling, and production safety guidelines.

shortCourses.title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
shortCourses.description: Defensive perimeter fundamentals, zero-trust hygiene, malware classification, threat hunting, and compliance standards.

shortCourses.title: Introduction to IoT & Digital Transformation
shortCourses.description: Sensor networks, microcontroller telemetry, MQTT protocols, cloud edge processing, and industrial IoT architecture.

shortCourses.title: Introduction to Data Science
shortCourses.description: Exploratory data analysis, statistical methods, Python data pipelines, visualization frameworks, and predictive modeling.

shortCourses.title: Linux Unleashed (Linux Unhatched)
shortCourses.description: Command-line mastery, shell scripting, package management, POSIX permissions, and foundational administration for cloud engineers.

shortCourses.title: Soft Skills — Creating Compelling Reports
shortCourses.description: Executive technical writing, structured engineering proposals, executive summaries, data storytelling, and stakeholder presentation.

workshopTracks.title: Artificial Intelligence & Generative AI
workshopTracks.summary: Production-ready AI architectures, generative agents, and ethical enterprise adoption.

workshopTracks.title: Cybersecurity Essentials
workshopTracks.summary: Defending corporate networks and critical computing infrastructure against modern threat actors.

workshopTracks.title: Networking & Digital Infrastructure
workshopTracks.summary: Modern enterprise architectures, hybrid multi-cloud pipelines, and software-defined WANs.

workshopTracks.title: IoT & Smart Technology
workshopTracks.summary: Sensor fusion, industrial robotics, intelligent manufacturing, and edge computing.

workshopTracks.title: Professional Engineering Development
workshopTracks.summary: International registration pathways, competency portfolios, AER, and intPE accreditation.

speakers.name: Dr. Desiderio A. Apag III
speakers.title: CHED Commissioner & ICpEP National President
speakers.organization: Commission on Higher Education / ICpEP National
speakers.topic: The Future of Filipino Engineering Education & Global Excellence
speakers.bio: Commissioner of the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) and National President of the Institute of Computer Engineers of the Philippines, leading the vanguard of engineering education reform, international accreditation, and professional advancement.

speakers.name: Engr. Leopoldo M. Maglalang Jr.
speakers.title: ICpEP-Oman President & Chair, PTC Engineers Registration Board
speakers.topic: Pathways to Professional Engineering Registration & Leadership
speakers.bio: President of ICpEP-Oman and Chairman of the PTC Engineers Registration Board, pioneering overseas credentialing pathways, ASEAN engineer conferments, and bilateral professional linkages in the GCC.

speakers.name: Dr. Abdullah Al-Badi
speakers.title: Chairman, IEEE Oman Chapter
speakers.organization: IEEE Oman Section / Sultan Qaboos University
speakers.topic: Maintaining High Renewable Energy Penetration in Modern Power Grids
speakers.bio: Distinguished academician, power systems engineer, and Chairman of the IEEE Oman Section, leading research initiatives in grid decarbonization, renewable energy integration, and smart utility infrastructure in Oman.

speakers.name: Engr. Raymond Careon
speakers.title: Project Engineer
speakers.topic: Enabling the Intelligent Factory: Hardware, Software & Smart SMT
speakers.bio: Senior project engineer at ASMPT SMT Solutions Mexico with extensive cross-continental expertise in surface-mount technology automation, smart manufacturing telemetry, and Industry 4.0 execution.

speakers.name: Engr. Reginald Norris Hernandez
speakers.title: AI Enthusiast Manager – Network Solution
speakers.topic: From Strategy to Scale: Building Secure, Production-Ready AI Solutions
speakers.bio: Enterprise network solution architect and AI infrastructure specialist at CDW Canada, advising Fortune 500 enterprises on deploying scalable neural network clusters, high-speed fabric interconnects, and zero-trust data topologies.

speakers.name: Engr. Trese Bustamante
speakers.title: Vice Chair, PTC-ERB & PTC-MENA International Affairs
speakers.topic: Engineering Beyond Borders: ASEAN Recognition & MENA Practice
speakers.bio: Vice Chairman of the PTC Engineers Registration Board and leading architect of PTC-MENA international affairs, mentoring hundreds of ASEAN and International Professional Engineers across the Middle East.

speakers.name: Engr. Federico A. Monsada
speakers.title: President
speakers.topic: Global Mobility and Mutual Recognition Agreements for Engineers
speakers.bio: President of the Philippine Technological Council, heading the umbrella organization of professional engineering institutions and stewarding the Philippines' full signatory standing in the Washington Accord.

speakers.name: Engr. Jonathan PG Tambaoan
speakers.title: ICpEP-Oman VP Education
speakers.bio: Vice President for Education of ICpEP-Oman, spearheading digital learning academies, technical workshops, and CPD accreditation programs for overseas computing engineers.

speakers.name: Dr. Ferdi Canlas
speakers.title: Panel Moderator & Distinguished Educator
speakers.topic: Industry Leaders Panel: What Skills Will Engineers/IT/ComSci Need in the Next Five Years?
speakers.bio: Esteemed academic leader and senior technology educator serving as the moderator for the Industry Leaders Panel, facilitating strategic discourse on artificial intelligence, cloud modernization, zero-trust cybersecurity, and career competencies for future computer engineers.

speakers.name: Engr. Gerry Manglicmot
speakers.title: PTC-Presidential Adviser
speakers.topic: AER & intPE Conferment Ceremonies and Global Engineering Standards
speakers.bio: Presidential Adviser for the Philippine Technological Council Global MENA – Oman, championing continuous credentialing, ASEAN Engineer registries, and welfare for Filipino engineering practitioners across the Sultanate of Oman.

speakers.name: Engr. Romy R. Agatep
speakers.title: Chair, PTC Engineers Registration Board
speakers.topic: Charging of the Conferees & Ethics of International Practice
speakers.bio: Chairman of the PTC Engineers Registration Board (PTC-ERB), administering the formal charging of candidate engineers for both the ASEAN Engineer Registry and the International Professional Engineer register.

speakers.name: Dr. Ana Shiela Crisostomo
speakers.title: ICpEP-Oman VP Internal
speakers.topic: Institutional Synergy, Internal Governance & Regional Computing Milestones
speakers.bio: Vice President for Internal Affairs of ICpEP-Oman Chapter, guiding chapter governance, membership empowerment, institutional partnerships, and regional computer engineering events.
